name: MeterReadExceptionWorkbench
tagline: Resolve every missed, high or estimated read before it bills.
description: VEE exception workbench for electric, gas and water utilities: high / low / zero usage checks against history and neighbours, missed and gap reads, duplicates, rollovers and meter exchanges, estimate, correct, accept, re-read and billing holds, and the pre-billing release per cycle – in canvas, model-driven and Power Pages.
features: VEE checks: high / low / zero usage vs 12-month history and neighbours
Missed, gap and duplicate reads, negative reads and register rollover
Estimate by history, same period last year, neighbours or manual – with consecutive-estimate limit
Correct / override and accept as valid with supervisor limit
Field re-read orders with phone and Power Pages contractor flow
Pre-billing release per billing cycle with ReleaseBatchJson
Bulk assign / estimate / re-read / release, undo, CSV export
Power Fx outputs and events, demo mode, phone layout
